executiveSummary: GM1658 passes the complete deterministic model contract for all ten canonical presets, T+0/6/12/24/48/72 and all eight essential services. Its 2025 CBS/PDOK identity, 17,075 residents, 33 neighbourhoods, three BAG places, nineteen BRT settlement labels, Heeze railway station, 34 scheduled-transit stop areas and four A2/N396 municipal-border routes are coherent. Release is nevertheless correction-required. Heeze-Leende's material water pathways are the Sterkselsche Aa, Groote Aa, Kleine Dommel, groundwater, sewer and pluvial systems, while the generic major-river preset assigns 1.030933 normalized direct flood stress from T+12 through T+72, 5,375 affected people-equivalent at T+24 and 5,825 at T+72 without a named Rhine, Meuse or IJssel pathway, selected LIWO case or local hydraulic model. The municipal water plan identifies specific 70 mm/hour road and tunnel hotspots, drainage interaction with high Groote Aa levels, about 244 km of sewer and nineteen sewer pumping stations; none drives the output. Eight unrelated nonzero hazard families reuse one exact 33-neighbourhood order. A controlled ignition inside the official Huize Providentia combustible-nature polygon and Kloostervelden leaves its source neighbourhood twentieth. Nature-fire, A2/rail, care-campus, wastewater, drinking-water, utility and external acute-care dependencies remain context rather than a causal first-72-hour graph. Retain real hazard eligibility and clearly labelled synthetic exercises; suppress unsupported local rank, affected, service and recovery precision. NoData, a register no-match, a plan or an external observation never means zero, safe, operational or completed.

evidenceSources.title: E01 — Wijken en buurten 2025, full administrative geometry, BAG places and BRT settlements
evidenceSources.edition: 2025 administrative/statistical editions; generated sources retrieved 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-02
supports: Fresh CBS OData row GM1658 reports Heeze-Leende, 17,075 residents, density 164/km², 4,489 residents age 65+ and 2,180 one-person households. CBS cells are independently rounded or suppressed and nulls are not zeros.

The current non-generalized GM1658 geometry has 1,210 coordinate positions, versus 73 positions in the generated overview geometry; the generated center [5.564226175145788, 51.36316923376926] lies inside both.

The consumed regional data contain 33 neighbourhoods, three active BAG places (Heeze, Leende and Sterksel) and nineteen BRT settlement labels. Administrative geography is not a catchment, fire compartment, evacuation zone or utility topology.
CBS/administrative data are CC BY 4.0 and BAG/PDOK is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Edition, retrieval time, generalized/full-resolution role and missing-value semantics must remain visible.

evidenceSources.title: E02 — Plan Stedelijk Water 2023–2027, adopted 6 February 2023
supports: The municipality reports about 244 km sewer, nineteen sewer pumping stations, 310 outside-area pump units, 20 combined overflows, eleven storm outlets, seven treatment/buffer facilities, ten retention ponds, fourteen special rainwater facilities, 25 groundwater monitoring points and four wastewater monitoring points.
Wastewater is conveyed through four pumps to RWZI Eindhoven. This municipality statement is connection evidence; a nearest-point wastewater facility must not override it.

In the named 70 mm/hour stress test, Heeze and Leende cores are most vulnerable. Listed impassable-road hotspots include Molenhoeven/Oeffels/Lokert, De Ambachten/De Leuren, Wever/Kuiper/Wagenmaker, Jan Deckersstraat, Kapelstraat, Strabrecht, Nieuwendijk at Groote Aa, Margrietlaan and the A2 tunnel toward Leenderstrijp. Leenderstrijp and Sterksel roads remain passable only in that specific static case.

High Groote Aa levels can reduce drainage near Nieuwendijk; the plan also identifies culvert maintenance, pump-failure analysis and sewer-condition concerns at Weibossen and Engelse Tuin. These are policy/asset and scenario statements, not live failure or current passability.
The PDF has no machine event cadence, complete NoData mask, native causal raster contract or standard open-data reuse licence stated. It must not be reverse-engineered into an operational grid.

evidenceSources.title: E03 — Sterkselsche Aa catchment, Legger 2023, drought notice and Groote Heide programme
evidenceSources.edition: Legger Watersysteem 2023; project and notice pages current at retrieval 2026-09-03
supports: The Sterkselsche Aa catchment extends between Weert, Someren, Maarheeze, Heeze and Sterksel, joins the Groote Aa at Kasteel Heeze and then becomes the Kleine Dommel. The Sterkselsch Kanaal can supply water during drought and remove excess during wet periods.
The statutory Legger exposes brooks, storage, weirs, pumps, culverts, dikes/dams and maintenance duties. Register presence is not live operation, condition, capacity, connectivity or incident state.

A board notice dated 29 May 2026 announced a temporary abstraction prohibition from 30 May for the Kleine Dommel, Sterkselse Aa and canal due to drought, with stated exceptions. Whether it remains active requires the current authoritative prohibition map; a dated notice is not an evergreen state.

The Groote Heide programme describes a planned 300-million-litre Groot Huisven buffer, about 1,200 hectares, roughly 60 km of ditches and work from the second half of 2027 through 2032. Twelve deep Brabant Water wells are identified in the area, but planned restoration and well presence are not current capacity, production or network topology.
The project pages do not provide one licensed, versioned, machine-readable live hydraulic or operational feed. Missing state remains Unknown.

evidenceSources.title: E04 — Regionaal Risicoprofiel 2025–2028
evidenceSources.edition: Risk profile for 2025–2028, adopted April 2025 according to the later official regional policy publication
supports: The profile covers Heeze-Leende and explicitly identifies Groote Heide and Strabrechtse Heide in a region with 103 nature areas larger than 100 hectares and 25,827 hectares of nature; fire risk depends on vegetation, management, fuel, weather, ignition, water and access.

The 2010 Strabrechtse Heide fire demonstrated that routes through nature, including A2 and rail, and electricity infrastructure can be affected. Care institutions, recreation and other uses within nature areas complicate warning and evacuation.

Regional pluvial scenarios include overloaded sewers, impassable A2/rail, impaired care access and treatment overload. Vital-service failure, cyber and hazardous-material transport are also strategic scenarios.

This is strategic multi-year planning evidence with no live event cadence or standard reuse licence stated. It does not establish current probability, perimeter, resource availability, route state or checkpoint completion.

Controlled point [5.622469841269841, 51.35828888888891] lies inside IPO feature Huize Providentia (id 1658200547210, mixed forest, source holder Heeze-Leende, validity 2006-08-08) and CBS BU16580311 Kloostervelden.

The province describes the 1,850-hectare Strabrechtse Heide & Beuven as Noord-Brabant's largest contiguous heath area, with dry heath, dunes, wet heath and meres. Static nature-management context is not live fuel, ignition, occupancy, smoke or suppression state.

evidenceSources.edition: Mobility plan adopted 2023-05-22; NWB-light 2026-08-01; deployed OVapi schedule valid 2026-08-30 through 2026-12-12

The generated graph has four logical border routes: A2 toward Cranendonck, A2 toward Valkenswaard, numeric 002 toward Waalre and N396 toward Valkenswaard. The numeric 002 edge shares A2 lineage but has a distinct physicalCorridorId and requires alias/non-additivity review.

evidenceSources.title: E07 — Kloostervelden care-community and public facility context
evidenceSources.edition: Kempenhaeghe article dated 2024-02-23; RIVM acute-care survey 2026 v1.1; DUO deployed snapshot 2026-08-31
supports: Kempenhaeghe describes Kloostervelden as a former institution campus integrated with nature, care, housing and day activities, then hosting 176 care clients with serious intellectual/physical disabilities and epilepsy alongside about 500 new neighbours.
Those dated figures demonstrate a potentially vulnerable mixed community, not current client count, identifiable persons, evacuation need, staffing, backup power, transport or acceptance state.
The deployed cache contains twelve education locations, including special-education school De Berkenschutse, but no surveyed acute emergency department inside GM1658.

Nearest surveyed 24/7 acute facility is Anna Zorggroep in Geldrop, about 6.315 km straight-line from the municipal reference point, with eight rooms and 12,376 visits in 2025. RIVM CC0 annual capacity does not guarantee incident acceptance, route or travel time; DUO is CC BY and daily context.

evidenceSources.edition: Deployed context snapshots 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-03; LIWO 2025.1.6 / project 2025_0_1; individual records retain their own dates
supports: The full-boundary cache assigns 155 HWH objects: 149 weirs, two surface-water pumps and four sewer pumps, with no RWZI inside. HWH CC BY-SA 4.0 coverage is contributor-dependent and partial; point/register presence does not establish catchment, connection, compatible capacity, live control or performance.
Nearest HWH RWZI by straight line is Soerendonk at 6.013 km, while the municipal plan says wastewater goes to RWZI Eindhoven. Nearest-point selection must never infer connectivity.

One NBNL postcode sample for Enexis/MZ Maarheeze contains grid-capacity planning and queue values and nineteen projects; it is not complete municipal topology, current load, outage, customer binding, reserve or restoration. Fifty RDI antenna records similarly do not establish service/backhaul or live coverage.

No KNMI station or RIVM PM2.5 station lies inside GM1658. Nearest observations were Eindhoven Airport 16.641 km away at 2026-09-02T23:30Z and Veldhoven-Europalaan 12.837 km away at 2026-09-02T17:00Z. Their source point/time values are context, not the municipality or future scenario state.

No municipal Waterinfo point is assigned; the nearest Blaarthem-Dommel observation, 10.509 km away, reported a true 0 m³/s at 2026-09-02T17:10Z. That zero is exact only for that external point, parameter and time. No assigned NDW situation or 365-day KNMI seismic event is a filtered no-match, not open roads or zero risk.

LIWO returns zero candidate breach points in the GM1658 bbox for primary, regional, regional-water-system and outside-dike catalogues. This is catalogue NoData/no-match, not proof of no brook, groundwater, sewer or pluvial exposure. LIWO causal use requires expert scenario selection and licence confirmation.

residualLimitations: This audits a deterministic first-72-hour exercise model, not a forecast, warning, flood assessment, evacuation plan, wildfire prediction, public-health instruction or operator commitment.
CBS values are rounded/suppressed and neighbourhood totals need not equal the municipality total; null heating/charging and absent operational records remain Unknown.
The overview boundary is selection/aggregation geometry only; full-resolution and native hazard/infrastructure geometry is required for brook, pluvial, fire, road and asset intersection.
Zero LIWO candidate points is a scoped catalogue no-match, not proof that brook, sewer, groundwater, pluvial or other flood mechanisms are impossible.
Municipal water-plan stress results, asset lengths/counts and condition concerns are planning/scenario evidence, not current failure, passability, capacity or a causal grid.
Waterschap Legger and HWH/DAMO objects do not establish connected catchments, compatible throughput, live controls, power/backup, water quality, overflow or restoration.
Risicokaart/provincial nature evidence identifies old/static eligibility context, not ignition, fuel/moisture, perimeter, smoke, visitors, care occupancy, access, firewater or suppression.
NWB/NDW/ProRail/GTFS and mobility plans do not establish incident-time route/rail-crossing passability, transport vehicles, emergency exemptions, evacuation capacity or hospital reachability.
Kempenhaeghe's 2024 community figures are dated aggregate context, not current identifiable clients, dependency, staffing, backup or evacuation requirements.
